summary: Replay one FIDASIM halo population-iteration feedback boundary: the density growth guard, the merge_neutral_populations density update, the seed_dcx fraction, and the next n_halo marker count with Fortran truncation.

identity.relation: density_ratio = current/previous; if density_ratio > 1 the round exits before updating previous/merge/seed with stop_reason='density_growth_exceeded' and null seed/marker/merge projections (previous state kept); otherwise merged_after = previous_merged + current (addition order per the source merge), next_previous = current, seed = current/dcx, next_markers = int(source_budget * seed) with Fortran truncation toward zero for the nonnegative product, continue = seed >= 0.01 (equality continues), stop_reason 'continue' or 'seed_below_threshold'.
identity.direction: DCX seed density + previous/current HALO density + pre-merge cumulative density + positive source marker budget -> ratio, seed fraction, next marker count, updated previous/merged state, merge flag, continuation selector and explicit stop reason
identity.definition: The saved FIDASIM DCXHalo迭代反馈 operator (framework node N3 neutral_population_transport), materializing one round of src/fidasim.f90:13293-13420 (n_halo initialization, cur_pop density, growth guard, previous update, merge_neutral_populations, seed_dcx and next-round n_halo). All state is caller-owned explicit density; the operator reads no reservoir, HDF5, RNG or source runtime. A null output means the source has not defined that follow-up state on the growth branch, not a filled zero.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, ported verbatim with registered finite-output gates
identity.geometry: scalar population densities for one beam-grid cell or rank-local aggregation point
identity.coordinates: densities in cm^-3; marker counts dimensionless; the source marker budget is inputs%n_halo, the fixed per-round base, not the previous round's actual count
identity.boundary: finite real scalars; dcx and previous strictly positive; current and pre-merge cumulative nonnegative; source marker budget a positive integral (bools rejected); all outputs finite (registered)
assumptions: The caller owns the population state sequence and supplies densities already generated by the source-ordered iteration.
Full Monte Carlo, reservoir sampling, MPI/OpenMP ownership and HDF5 writers remain outside this relation.

inputs.name: dcx_density_cm3
inputs.description: Source DCX seed density for the seed_dcx fraction.

inputs.name: previous_halo_density_cm3
inputs.description: Previous-generation HALO density used by the growth ratio.

inputs.name: current_halo_density_cm3
inputs.description: Current cur_pop density after one source iteration.

inputs.name: previous_merged_halo_density_cm3
inputs.description: Cumulative HALO density immediately before the source merge.

inputs.name: source_halo_marker_budget
inputs.description: Source inputs%n_halo base budget used for seed scaling each round.
inputs.constraints: Positive integer (registered: bools, NumPy bools and non-integrals rejected).

outputs.name: density_ratio
outputs.constraints: Finite (registered: an overflowing ratio raises instead of returning Inf).

outputs.name: seed_dcx_fraction
outputs.description: current/dcx source seed fraction; null on the growth-exit branch.

outputs.name: next_halo_marker_count
outputs.description: int(source_budget * seed_dcx) with Fortran truncation; null on the growth-exit branch.
outputs.constraints: Nonnegative when present; computed in double precision - the product source_budget * seed must stay finite and representable (registered hardening; the exact-integer domain of the product is |budget * seed| within double-precision range, and budgets beyond 2^53 round in that product exactly as in the source's default-REAL arithmetic).

outputs.name: next_previous_halo_density_cm3
outputs.description: Previous density after the round: current when accepted, unchanged previous on the growth exit.

outputs.name: merged_halo_density_after_cm3
outputs.description: Cumulative density after the source merge; null on the growth-exit branch.

outputs.name: merge_applied
outputs.description: Whether the source merge_neutral_populations density update ran this round.

preconditions: Caller-owned explicit population densities in the source's own generation order.
supported: One bounded N3 HALO population-iteration feedback step with explicit marker-budget recurrence.
excluded: Full Monte Carlo, reservoir sampling, MC marker production, plasma/track/colrad evaluation, MPI/OpenMP ownership, HDF5 writers and downstream terminals.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when any density is non-finite or mis-typed, when dcx or previous is non-positive, when current or the pre-merge cumulative density is negative, or when the marker budget is not a positive integer (bools and non-integrals rejected).
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError when the density ratio, seed fraction, marker product budget*seed, or merged density overflows to non-finite (or the product is not representable in double precision) for finite but extreme input magnitudes (registered hardening); the saved arm returns Inf silently or crashes inside int(Inf) with a bare OverflowError.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; the operator executes one round and reports the source's explicit continuation selector.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; the growth-exit mapping is the source-defined complete answer for that branch.

example.description: The saved package's seed probe: current 55.9 on dcx/previous 100 with budget 40 continues with marker count 22; growth exits before the merge.
example.code:
from scirel.fusion import advance_halo_iteration_feedback
result = advance_halo_iteration_feedback(100.0, 100.0, 55.9, 10.0, 40)
assert result['stop_reason'] == 'continue' and result['next_halo_marker_count'] == 22
assert result['merged_halo_density_after_cm3'] == 65.9 and result['merge_applied']
growth = advance_halo_iteration_feedback(100.0, 100.0, 100.1, 10.0, 40)
assert growth['stop_reason'] == 'density_growth_exceeded' and not growth['merge_applied']
assert growth['seed_dcx_fraction'] is None and growth['next_halo_marker_count'] is None
boundary = advance_halo_iteration_feedback(100.0, 100.0, 1.0, 10.0, 100)
assert boundary['seed_dcx_fraction'] == 0.01 and boundary['continue_iteration']
try:
    advance_halo_iteration_feedback(1.0e-308, 1.0e308, 1.0e308, 10.0, 40)
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('an overflowing seed fraction must fail closed (registered hardening)')
example.expected: The saved seed probe, growth exit and 0.01 boundary reproduce; the overflowing seed fraction raises ValueError.
